_comment: Order store for managing multiple orders. Multiple orders can have 'execute: true' and will be queued based on queue_id.

_instructions.execute: Set to true to mark this order for execution
_instructions.success: Automatically set to true after successful execution
_instructions.queue_id: (Optional) Queue position for execution (1, 2, 3, etc.). Orders with execute=true are executed in ascending queue_id order. If not specified, defaults to 999.
_instructions.quantity: Number of units for the FINAL ladder level (or all levels if base_quantity not specified)
_instructions.base_quantity: (Optional) Number of units for all ladder levels EXCEPT final level (default: 10). Only applies to IPO modes.
_instructions.limit: (Optional) Upper limit price for IPO and IPO-trigger modes
_instructions.time: (Optional) Scheduled execution time in HH:MM or HH:MM:SS format
_instructions.refresh_before: (Optional) Seconds before execution to refresh tokens (default: 20)
_instructions.sell: (Optional) Set to true for sell order, false/omit for buy order
_instructions.skip_first: (Optional) For IPO-trigger mode: skip first ladder level (default: false)
_instructions.skip_second_last: (Optional) For IPO-trigger mode: skip second-to-last ladder level (the level before final limit order) (default: false)
_instructions.no_ladder: (Optional) For IPO-trigger mode: skip ALL ladder levels, only place final order at limit+10% when LTP reaches second-to-last level. Overrides skip_first and skip_second_last (default: false)
